reasons: At most 1 module per semester conflicts with the must that CS2103T and CS4330 be in the same semester, which would put 2 modules in one semester.
Even ignoring that, 7 required courses cannot fit into semesters 3-8 with a maximum of 1 module per semester (only 6 slots).
